Got you, short version. What does the error say word for word? And are you on the college's login page in a browser or in an app?

browser. it says identity verification failed try again. it wants my student id and drivers license number. i got them in my notes app, 4471829 and D8834102. brakes lab ran 8 to 11 today and engine performance is 1-4 so this is the only time i can do it. need it sorted before Salas class thursday, he wants the lab form turned in

Thanks, that helps. I'm not going to repeat those numbers back here, so just copy and paste them straight from your notes into the form. Most common cause of that error is a typo, a stray space, or the wrong letter case.

Quick steps:
1. Close the tab and reopen the login page.
2. Tap the student ID field. Paste it, then delete any space at the end.
3. Tap the license field. Paste it, check the letter at the start is capitalized, no dashes or spaces.
4. Don't use autofill, since it can fill the wrong field.
5. Tap Verify.

If it fails again, tell me which field turns red.
ok explain it like im looking at the screen not the book. its got 3 boxes

Okay, looking at the screen top to bottom:

Box 1 (top): student ID. Paste it, nothing else.
Box 2 (middle): driver's license. Paste it, make sure there's no space on either end.
Box 3 (bottom): usually a date of birth or a checkbox. Fill that in last.

Then hit the big button under them. A box that turns red is the one with the problem. If the page freezes, switch your phone to Chrome and try once more.
ok the middle one had a space at the end. fixed it and it went thru 👍 now its showing the sign up page. its for the ASE G1 practice test, i need it for the shop internship. its scheduled nov 18

Nice, that space was the culprit. On the sign-up page:

1. Tap the G1 practice test option.
2. Pick the Nov 18 date and time slot.
3. Tap Confirm and screenshot the confirmation so you have proof.

Then go to the brakes lab makeup option and do the same. Plug in your phone while you do it so it doesn't die before you hit confirm.
